text:
Kevin M: Heads-up: hit sustained pool saturation in eu-west-2a last night. Grafana shows pending queue growth + avg_batch_size dropped. Autoscaler didn't spin new nodes.
Maria G: link: https://grafana.redwood-infra/d/xyz/pool-observability?panelId=7&var-pool=eu-west-2a
Panels: Pool saturation, pending_requests_per_gpu, avg_batch_size, scale_events
Sanjay R: I saw scale events: `scale_up_attempt` at 03:12 failed with reason=insufficient_quotas
ops-bot: incident-bot: scale_event: pool=eu-west-2a action=scale_up status=FAILED reason=quota_exhausted
Liz H: Is this the same pattern as last month? That one was due to a batch size config change in router service.
Maria G: different — avg_batch_size fell from 12->4 as queues lengthened, so per-GPU throughput dropped, increasing latency.
Kevin M: PromQL I'm looking at:
```
sum by (pool) (rate(requests_processing_seconds_count[5m])) / sum by (pool) (max_gpu_capacity) * 100
```
(not perfect but useful)
Ashley P: Can we untangle where batches are being cut? Maybe router's `max_batch_time_ms` kicked earlier.
Sanjay R: We should add a panel for `pending_requests / available_slots` and an alert when > 0.6 for >5m
Liz H: :thumbsup: Also add a `scale_up_failed` alert to notify infra on-call with reason tag
Maria G: Proposed alert tweaks:
- pool_saturation > 0.9 for 3m -> severity=page
- pending_ratio > 0.6 for 5m -> severity=page
- avg_batch_size < 6 for 10m -> ticket to eng-runtime
Any objections?
Kevin M: Prefer 2m for saturation, this needs quick reaction.
Ashley P: We also need to track `cold_start_rate` (new pod startup > 10s) — that's why queue built up.
Sanjay R: Runbook draft:
1) check grafana panel -> pool
2) look at `scale_events` in logs
3) if scale_up_failed -> check quota via cloud console
4) if quota OK -> toggle router max_batch_time to 50ms
5) if still saturated -> emergency reserve 'burst' pool
Maria G: I'll add panels + alerts, and create PR for runbook. Assign to on-call for 24h watch.
Kevin M: Thanks. Also capture cost signal: we spiked GPU-hours by 28% the previous week; need to audit burst policy.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: dashboards/observability/pool-panels updated in staging (PR #4821)
Ashley P: I'll run a synthetic load to reproduce in staging and collect detailed traces.
Liz H: Great. If anyone is free tomorrow morning let's do a quick postmortem and decide whether to change default router batching.
Sanjay R: tagging @oncall-infra so they get page when alerts fire
Maria G: noted. I'll post the PR link once ready.
